Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Zoya - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Tanay - 10 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
5. Vimla - 67 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Kavita and Vimla stand near him.]

Ayaan: "Grandma, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan: "What happened?"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Ayaan: "What next?"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Kavita (laughing): "And then?"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan (softly): "That was fun!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan milks the cow.]

Kavita: "What happened?"

[Ayaan pats his horse.]

Kavita: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Zoya and Tanay stand near him.]

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan opens his umbrella.]

Ayaan (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Ayaan puts on his raincoat.]

Kavita: "Ayaan, are you okay?"

[The rain stops.]

Zoya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
